headline: Weathered and Marban Register Fresh Base Fighting
war_summary: The latest returns show the contested belt shifting markedly since the previous edition. WeatheredExpanse has climbed from 51 to 64 strategic-base events in 24 hours and now records 14 in the latest two hours, though casualty and enlistment rates are cooling; its ledger stands at four Warden, three Colonial, and two neutral bases. MarbanHollow has advanced from 30 to 35 daily events, with eight in two hours and both casualty rates accelerating across a mixed holding of one Warden, six Colonial, and one neutral base. KuuraStrand has become a fresh point of activity, recording five events in two hours and ten in the day, with four Colonial and two Warden bases. PariPeak has likewise reached 18 events, four of them recent, while LinnMercy shows five events in two hours amid a nine-Colonial, one-Warden, one-neutral ledger. Gutter remains the day’s busiest broad front at 73 events, but its previous 91-event pace has slackened and no change was logged in two hours. Several rear sectors remain quiet.
